# Words that differ when a frame is resimulated (values derived from engine-side
# transforms). Left out of desync checksums.
# <region size> <word offset, hex>
# 600 and 1408: pool bookkeeping (one pair per player, plus extra pools some characters keep between battles); never written during a match, contents are allocation history. Masked whole.
# 392 +0x10..+0x110 and 304 +0x118..+0x128: Oro, effect handles and halves of heap addresses the game copies in on the first tick (per process).
# 884 +0x350 / +0x358 (Rose's soul level, entity +0x444/+0x448) are no longer masked: the level was picked from a per-process random stream; the mod now reseeds that pick from the battle tick (battle_driver.cpp).
# 13092 +0x32b8: P2's input history; a heap pointer for a dozen frames at the start of the fight with V-Skill / V-Trigger II (scan-loadouts.ps1, 2026-10-28).
# Words that point into DLLs (sfvr images): equal in two processes on one PC, different between PCs (one load address per boot); learned from every recording.
# 44 +0x20 and +0x28: timer and state of a trail effect object (16 slots) that starts once something loaded in the background is there, a tick apart on two games; presentation only.
# 884 +0x0..+0x2d0 (every 0x30): Rose, heap pointers in a 16-entry array with V-Skill / V-Trigger II (scan-loadouts.ps1, 2026-10-28).
# 372 +0x98, 392 +0x0 and 224 +0xd8: small counters / a flag that drifted apart by one on one PC with no rollback and spread to nothing else (re-converged or stayed alone for 800+ frames); taken for presentation.
